one_line: Show the box, lay out the contents top-down, then end on the finished result held beside the box art.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a small hand holds the kit box up to the lens, art facing us ("DAS junior", "JUNGLE FRIENDS"); 0:02 the lid opens on markers, glue and dough. No speech, no text, no face.
q1_hook.why: The box is in hand in the first frame with large, readable art, and the lid opens by 0:02 (S1, H3, F4, H2). But nothing is said or written, so there is no promise, question or reason to stay (H1, T3, H6), and no face or voice (H4).

beats.what: A small hand holds up the box, sets it down and opens the lid
Top-down: markers, cutters, stencil, dough, glue and booklet laid out
Child's hands cut pink dough with a round cutter and draw on the circles
beats.why: First making step, easy to follow

beats.what: Hands cut white dough with cutters
Hands draw with a brown marker, shape pieces with a stencil and a green tool
beats.why: The pieces start to look like a panda

beats.what: Hands glue the panda face and parts together
The finished panda stands before the box art with pink dough flowers; a panda sticker
beats.why: The result matches the picture on the box

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "תגיבי פה ואשלח לך קישור לערכה" (comment for a link) and "איך יצאה הפנדה של [the child's name]?". The video itself asks nothing.
q2_flow.why: With no text, a silent maker's sequence opens an unspoken loop (what is being made?) that closes at 0:25 (H5, R4). Each step is a new action every 4 to 5 s (R3, K2). At 27 s it stops right after the payoff (R1, E8). Nothing tells the viewer what to expect early.

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, mid-text: "אם מעניין אותך, תגיבי פה ואשלח לך קישור לערכה 😇"; then a question about the finished panda; partner tags last. No comment word, no price.
q3_cta.why: A comment that delivers a real link has a purpose (C2, C3), but it names no keyword and sits mid-caption under "more", and the video ends with nothing said or shown (C6). The question after it is a second ask (C1).

q4_shown.what: The kit box at 0:00 (18 pieces printed on it); the open box and the contents at 0:02 to 0:05; a child's hands cutting, drawing and gluing the panda; the finished panda before the box art at 0:25. No price, no face.
q4_shown.why: The whole make is shown in use, and the finished panda beside the box art that pictures a panda is checkable proof (S1, F8). Only hands appear, so no child's face is shown (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 15 shots in 27 s (first pass), about 1.8 s each, static top-down jump cuts that skip the waiting. No speed changes seen. No voice, no text; one panda sticker at the end. Ends on the result.
q5_edit.why: Time-skip cuts keep out dead air (E2, R1), and the fixed top-down frame is easy to read (F5). With no voice and no text, nothing carries the message for sound off or on (E4, T1). It ends on the result with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A child makes a panda from a dough craft kit, step by step, in a quiet sequence; it serves parents looking for a calm creative activity.
q6_topic.why: A cute result built step by step gives a small payoff (K2). The mood is calm, below the high-arousal feelings K1 favours, and it names no parent worry or occasion (K6, K7). The useful facts (age 3 and up, air-drying, gluten free) are only in the caption (K4).

q7_filmed.what: One handheld close-up of the box at 0:00, then static top-down shots of a child's hands on a white table in even daylight; a static medium shot of the finished panda before the box art. No face.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down, hands-only framing puts the viewer in the maker's seat (F5, S4), on a clean white table in even light that keeps colours clear (F7, E6).

q8_text.on_screen: None. No headline, subtitles, price or CTA in any frame; only a panda emoji sticker at 0:25 to 0:27 and the printed box text ("DAS junior", "ART LAB", "JUNGLE FRIENDS").
q8_text.caption: "ערכת יצירה דאס ג׳וניור 🐼". About 122 words: what the kit includes, dough facts (air-drying, gluten free, age 3 and up), the comment-for-link ask, a question about the finished panda, 5 hashtags, partner tags last.
q8_text.why: With no text or voice, the topic and benefit live only in the caption (T1, T3, H6). The caption opens with the kit's name and uses searchable words and 5 specific hashtags (T7). The partnership is named in words, but on the last lines (T8, S7).

weak_points: No text, voice or headline; nothing promised in the first seconds; the comment ask only mid-caption; a child's name in the caption's closing question; the collaboration named last; no price.
lumebook_takeaway: Film it silent and top-down on a table: box first, contents laid out, one action every 2 s, end on the result beside the box.
not_verified: Whether the hand is a child's or the creator's (sleeves look child-sized, judged by eye); music (not established); the price; the second tag in the caption (partly cut). Frame size 1440 x 2560 is from the video info. Cut count from the first pass. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
